name: quantum_orrery
theme: a brass orrery in a night study — a planet bead's metal grain folds into a bubble-chamber realm of particle tracks, and the bound quark trio resolves back into the orrery's three-armed hub

registers.name: study
registers.palette: warm amber lamplight and dark timber
registers.scene: a cluttered astronomer's study at night seen from across the room at desk height, dark timber shelves crowded with books and rolled star charts, a brass lamp burning low, tall black windows behind the desk, empty, no one present, a gleaming brass orrery standing on the desk among the papers
registers.target: a gleaming brass orrery, curved armatures and concentric graduated rings
registers.loop_target: the cluttered astronomer's study at night, dark timber shelves of books and star charts, a brass orrery on the desk under a low-burning lamp, empty, no one present

registers.name: orrery
registers.scene: a brass orrery standing on a cluttered desk, slender curved armatures out from a central hub, concentric graduated rings scored with fine degree marks, small polished planet beads set along the arms, the dark study beyond the metal, empty, no one present
registers.target: a small deep-blue planet bead, a smooth round stone sphere with a thin brass collar

registers.name: bead_surface
registers.palette: deep blue stone and silver white
registers.scene: a deep-blue stone bead set on a slender brass arm, its polished curve covered in fine machined tool-marks, hairline circular grooves ringing the surface, a thin brass collar across one edge, a graduated ring behind it, faint metal grain under the polish
registers.target: a bright pale fleck of metal, a small angular crystal speck with sharp facets

registers.name: grain_mosaic
registers.scene: a mosaic of faceted crystal domains in polished metal, flat angular plates of pale gold at differing tilts, bright hairline seams along every boundary, violet shadow deep in the grooves between the plates

registers.name: chamber_realm
registers.palette: deep indigo and pale cyan light
registers.scene: a vast bubble-chamber realm of deep indigo fog, long pale spiral tracks of light curled through the depths, thin luminous filaments crossing far into the dark
registers.target: a bright triple-lobed core of gold-white light, three glowing points close together

registers.name: hadron
registers.palette: hot gold white and deep crimson
registers.scene: three glowing quark cores bound close inside one luminous shell, gold-white lobes with taut bright filaments strung between them, a crimson halo around the trio, indigo dark beyond
registers.target: a polished brass hub, three curved arms out from it

registers.name: orrery_hub
registers.scene: a polished brass hub at the centre of the orrery, three curved arms out from it, concentric engraved rings behind the metal, fine degree marks scored along every band, green verdigris deep in the crevices, warm lamplight across the brass

music_theme: a brass orrery alone in a night study, precise and hushed, plucked strings and a low clockwork pulse under a wide luminous swell that lands on the metal-grain morph
